uploadDocs.question: How do I upload documents?
uploadDocs.answer: Navigate to the Documents page and click the 'Upload Documents' button. You can drag and drop files or click to select them from your computer. Add metadata like title and description, then click Upload.

encryption.question: Are my documents encrypted?
encryption.answer: Yes! All documents are encrypted both in transit (using TLS) and at rest (using AES-256 encryption). Your data security is our top priority.

sharing.question: How do I share documents with others?
sharing.answer: Open a document and click the Share button. Enter the email address of the person you want to share with, select their permission level (View or Edit), and click Share. They will receive a notification.

recovery.question: Can I recover deleted documents?
recovery.answer: Deleted documents are moved to the Trash folder where they remain for 30 days before permanent deletion. You can restore them from the Trash during this period.

fileTypes.question: What file types are supported?
fileTypes.answer: We support a wide range of file types including PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, and various image formats (JPG, PNG, GIF). Maximum file size is 100MB per document.

twoFactor.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
twoFactor.answer: Go to Profile & Settings > Security and click 'Enable 2FA'. Follow the instructions to set up two-factor authentication using an authenticator app or SMS.

mobile.question: Can I access my documents on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes! Our application is fully responsive and works on all devices. Simply access the application through your mobile browser.

cancellation.question: What happens to my data if I cancel my subscription?
cancellation.answer: You will have 30 days to download your documents before they are permanently deleted. We recommend exporting all important documents before canceling.
